## DATA-3 — Case shelf with create and edit

### Result

Implemented the shelf route, ordered case cards, create/edit dialog, empty state, and recoverable database-error state. No deletion, storage-warning, readiness, or backup actions were added.

### Files created

- `src/features/shelf/CaseShelfPage.tsx`
- `src/features/shelf/CaseShelf.tsx`
- `src/features/shelf/CaseCard.tsx`
- `src/features/shelf/CaseFormDialog.tsx`
- `src/features/shelf/shelf.css`
- `tests/shelf/CaseShelf.test.tsx`
- `tests/shelf/CaseFormDialog.test.tsx`

### Files changed

- `src/app/routes.tsx` — lazily routes `/` to `CaseShelfPage`; adds optional `shelfRepository` / `loadShelfRepository` props for test injection.

### Acceptance criteria

| Criterion | Result |
|---|---|
| Shelf route replaces placeholder and renders persisted cases in exam-date order, undated last, then updatedAt descending | Pass |
| Valid create persists, selects/focuses the new card, and announces success | Pass |
| Empty title shows an announced inline error and writes nothing | Pass |
| Edit updates title/subject/exam date, refreshes the card and ordering, and restores focus | Pass |
| Empty state has exactly one primary create action and no dead controls | Pass |
| Repository open/read failure shows a recoverable error with Retry and `.ndcase` import guidance | Pass |
| Card links and edit actions are keyboard reachable with visible focus and 44px targets | Pass |

### Keyboard and input evidence

- Tab order exercised: `New case` → case link → `Edit <case>`.
- Create exercised by keyboard only: focus empty-state action, Enter, type title, Enter.
- Dialog initial focus lands on `Case title`; empty title returns focus to the invalid input.
- Escape closes the dialog and restores focus to the opening trigger.
- After create, focus moves to the newly selected card link; after edit, focus returns to that card’s Edit button.
- Retry moves focus to the first recovered case link.
- Some edit/recovery tests use pointer events for setup; all required controls were separately exercised with keyboard assertions.

Viewport: component tests run in jsdom, so no browser viewport matrix was exercised. Responsive CSS is defined for phone widths at `37.5rem`, but this is not browser-level evidence.

### Accessibility evidence

- Focus: dialog focus trap and restoration use the shared `Dialog`; shelf-specific focus-to-new-card and Retry focus are asserted.
- Announcements: `Field` renders title errors in `role="alert"`; save success uses the always-mounted polite `Toast` live region; the database error panel uses `role="alert"`.
- Targets: `.case-card__link`, `.nd-button`, and `.nd-field__control` all assert at least 44×44 CSS pixels.
- Contrast: no new palette literals; `shelf.css` consumes locked tokens only, and `shelf.css` is asserted to contain no hex/rgb/hsl values. The existing token contrast suite passes.
- Reduced motion: `.case-card` transition/animation removal is asserted under `prefers-reduced-motion`; no shelf animation was added.
- Plain text: all titles, subjects, and dates render through React text nodes; no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.

### Shared-file handoff

`src/app/routes.tsx` is foundation-owned. Preserve:
- the lazy named import `module.CaseShelfPage`;
- the optional `AppRoutesProps.shelfRepository` and `loadShelfRepository` forwarding.

`CaseShelfPage` itself accepts optional `repository` and `loadRepository` props for tests and future composition.

### Known gaps

- No Playwright/browser viewport or axe run was part of this task’s required validation commands.
- Whole-card pointer hit-testing is CSS-only and was not exercised in a real browser.
- Import guidance is intentionally text-only because backup/import UI belongs to BACKUP-* tasks.

### Validation run

- `npm test -- tests/shelf/CaseShelf.test.tsx tests/shelf/CaseFormDialog.test.tsx` → 14 passed
- `npm run typecheck` → passed
- `npm run build` → passed
- Additional checks: `npm run lint` → passed; full suite → 236 passed

`docs/artifacts/` was not modified. `docs/EXECUTION-AUDIT.jsonl` has a pre-existing engine change I did not author or touch.
